What should be done:
1. Update `package.json` to use `eslint` v9
2. Update [.eslintrc](https://github.com/ubiquity/ts-template/blob/7b94011f7e080380dd5517db6a0b80ec6d5ae965/.eslintrc) accroding to the [breaking changes](https://eslint.org/docs/latest/use/migrate-to-9.0.0)

4. Make sure `yarn lint-staged` works as expected
